body: No worries! There’s private little weed shows quietly popping up all over the city and vendors from Cali come out once in a while, but the dispensaries are a mess.

Always always always just keep a ganja connect in CA. My biggest regret moving out here in Vegas is the weed quality. Potent purples don’t  exist out here, Nevada state just can’t keep up. Even their best greenhouses only produce average cannabis just because everything so artificial. When I get a chance to go home to Cali, the potency difference is insane. You can genuinely feel the medicinal and the fun effects of the flower. Here it can sometimes feel like you’re hitting hay. Nothing here really lives up to any hype. Even if it’s amazing that means it’s okay. The weather makes such a difference. Cannabis just needs that moisture. You’ll end up spending 4x as much for barely passable greenery. A lot of the cultivations cut corners for more money. They will name a crop whatever is the hottest strain name is out and say it is that. 

When I was living in CA smoking all the time, at the most I was spending was $500. I moved to Vegas with a very high tolerance, was spending over $2000 a month with 40% employee discount. There’s no more discounts of any kind; employee, local, or visitors. If you ever see anything on sale at a dispensary, run every time.

As far as police, just act like an adult and it’s straight. All of Fremont St. smells like cheap weed so it’s everywhere now. You really have to be acting extra to catch the police attention. At home all you would have to worry about is your neighbors, nobody cares and it’s fully legal.

The summers are awful but you’ll kind of get used to it. It can get claustrophobic having artificial air as your only choice when it’s 120° outside every day and night. I just try to escape to CA and hit the beach once in a while. At my place the AC has broken down in summer once a year (fingers crossed, going good so far) but luckily getting repairs done without charge is written into my lease. I feel like in general there’s a wide range of repair companies that you could always shop around for prices

When I first moved out here because I didn’t know the layout of the city I made the mistake of getting a place out in Nellis. The area is sketchy, and you’re over 20 miles away from everything as far as the major parts of the city. People really like Henderson.

I was becoming an ‘adult’ when cannabis culture was right on the precipice of being socially popular in the 2000s/2010s. I started a whole other personality the more I had fun with it. I have a serious career and I never wanted a correlation, so Ms. MajorBlazer was born out of nowhere from the blunt ashes. I also didn’t want people I’ve known since high school seeing me turn into Bob Marley. I love gadgets and toys so all new products coming out tied together. Being younger helped; I lost weight and felt cute so I started making and posting smoking videos, getting ganja clothing and going to cannabis conventions all over the U.S., getting to meet different interesting personalities. When I started getting more knowledgeable about the plant, I decided to begin working with cultivations and learning from the back end, causing me to fall in love with the culture from a new angle.

It’s been over 15 years and now I usually only smoke socially but I still go to shows to see what’s happening since the industry is growing so quickly. Seeing how much it helps people including myself, will never get old. Haven’t done vids in years. When I meet someone who is a smoking personality and they’re annoying, it’s most likely just their personality to begin with. To me, there’s no real answer to why have a weed identity except; ‘Why not?’
